locator.section: 8.4 Reaction initiation at radical or charge sites

evidence.curator_note: alpha-cleavage of the n-ionized 2-methylpiperidine molecular ion (Budzikiewicz et al. 1967, p.316; the alpha-cleavage product ion of Equation 8.34). Convention B/C localization: the molecular ion is drawn '+.' on the ring nitrogen, so the mapped SMILES places BOTH the charge and the odd electron on N (map 1): [NH+] with two ring bonds + one N-H is a 3-connection nitrogen aminium radical cation (RDKit assigns the one unpaired electron automatically). alpha-cleavage of the C2-CH3 bond (map2-map7) expels CH3. (map 7), forms the C2=N+ iminium pi bond (map1-map2) and gives the closed-shell cyclic iminium ion (2,3,4,5-tetrahydropyridinium, C5H10N+, m/z 84, an intermediate not printed on the page). ARC COUNT: Book draws 2 arc(s) on the molecular ion (the two fishhooks at C2/N) - move <1> (the odd electron on N, map 1, into the forming C2=N pi bond) is the lower fishhook, move <2> (one electron of the breaking C2-CH3 sigma bond into that same pi bond) is the upper fishhook. Move <3> (the other C2-CH3 electron onto the departing methyl carbon, map 7, its new radical site) is the implicit homolysis hook required for electron balance (not drawn on the page; CH3. is simply written as '-CH3' over the arrow).

locator.section: 8.4 Reaction initiation at radical or charge sites (retro-Diels-Alder of the alpha-cleavage product ion, arrow labelled 'i')

evidence.curator_note: retro-Diels-Alder of the cyclic iminium ion (arrow labelled 'i'): the closed-shell six-membered iminium (ring N1=C2-C3-C4-C5-C6) undergoes a concerted retro-[4+2], expelling neutral ethylene (from C4-C5, maps 4/5) and giving the conjugated 2-aza-1,3-butadiene cation CH2=CH-N+(H)=CH2 (maps 3=2-1=6), m/z 56, exactly as drawn. ARC COUNT: Book draws 3 arc(s) inside the iminium ring and all three are encoded as double-barbed (2-electron) arrows - move <1> (top-right arc): the N1=C2 pi pair shifts to the C2-C3 bond (forms C2=C3); move <2> (left arc): the C3-C4 sigma pair shifts to the C4-C5 bond (forms the C4=C5 of ethylene, breaking C3-C4); move <3> (bottom arc): the C5-C6 sigma pair shifts to the N1-C6 bond (forms N1=C6, breaking C5-C6). Both cleaved ring sigma bonds (C3-C4 and C5-C6) are the bonds beta to the ring double bond, correct retro-Diels-Alder geometry. The expelled CH3. of the first step is carried as an unreacting spectator through this state so the step stays atom-balanced. DELOCALIZATION (convention C): the m/z 56 product is written in the single Kekule form CH2=CH-N+(H)=CH2 that these arrows produce, matching the page drawing (vinyl at top, +NH, =CH2 at bottom).

NO MOD rule is assigned to Equation 8.34 (rule_index.json 'by_equation' has no 8.34 entry). Cross-link checked, not asserted: the retro-Diels-Alder rules IMS_4_31_alpha1/alpha2 are NOT a match - their DFS ('[C]1[C]2[C]3[C]4[C+]5[C.]6[C]7{-}2>>...') encodes a stepwise, radical-cation (OE+., note the [C+] and [C.]) retro-Diels-Alder of an all-carbon cyclohexene ring, whereas this scheme is a concerted, closed-shell (EE+) retro-[4+2] of a nitrogen-containing iminium ring, so neither the ring heteroatom nor the electron count matches. The alpha-cleavage step likewise has no dedicated 8.34 rule. Peak m/z: the ethylene monoisotopic neutral loss is 28.0313; the m/z 56 ion is 56.0495. The intermediate iminium (m/z 84.0808) is drawn but not printed with an m/z on the page.
